english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something elaborately decorative or unnecessarily elaborate and complicated.
Use this for a fussy, intricate, or showy design, especially when the decoration feels excessive or gimmicky.
Use this for a visibly fancy, flashy, or showy design, especially when the embellishment feels unnecessary.
Use this when something is fussy or unnecessarily elaborate in its design or presentation.

examples.english: This report is so fancy that it actually makes it hard to understand.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告寫到咁花巧，反而令人睇唔明。
